description: Native config gate and normalizer (cpp/update_flow_core/native_config.h), shared by the Android, iOS and Harmony orchestrators and replayed by scripts/test-update-flow-core.sh. `runnable`: the persisted config text -> RunnableConfigJson ({appKey} when a round may run, else {status, reason}); disabled follows JS truthiness and appKey is trimmed like String.prototype.trim. `normalize`: the options JSON a host passes to configure() -> the persisted config (`expected`, compared as text) or the error message (`error`). Hand-maintained.

runnable.name: trailing content after the object is invalid
JSON array is not a config
JSON null is not a config
JSON string is not a config
appKey trim follows String.prototype.trim (NBSP, ideographic space, BOM)
control characters other than TAB/LF/VT/FF/CR are not trimmed
duplicate keys: the last one wins
disabled wins over a missing appKey
disabled "false" is a non-empty string, so truthy

normalize.name: appKey alone takes Pushy's endpoints and discovery
custom endpoints get no default discovery and are deduplicated
explicit discovery, identity overrides and disabled
discovery URLs keep their trailing slash
empty rnu and rn are allowed
explicit defaults equal the omitted ones
not JSON
